sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: Offers a smooth, mild almond flavor; known for being a stomach-friendly, dairy-free alternative; the unsweetened version is sugar-free, making it suitable for diabetic people and weight loss; perceived as having cleaner ingredients than comparable brands; highly versatile for various culinary applications.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Almond Breeze is a brand of refrigerated almond milk offered by Blue Diamond, providing dairy-free alternatives in various flavors like Unsweetened Original, Original, Vanilla, and Unsweetened Vanilla. It is used as a versatile alternative to dairy milk for beverages, cooking, and baking.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Refrigerated almond milk
including Unsweetened Original
Original
Vanilla
and Unsweetened Vanilla Almondmilk.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Consumers seeking dairy-free or plant-based milk alternatives, individuals with lactose intolerance, and those looking for low-calorie or sugar-free beverage options to be used in coffee, cereal, smoothies, cooking, and baking.
